answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by requiring every identity to carry a mirrored public ledger of its past work: each completed job leaves a signed receipt peers can verify, so a fresh fake has no history to show. New agents begin in a probationary oasis where they only handle small tasks, and must earn an opal-grade reputation token through consistent reviewed work before touching larger contracts. Faking a hundred convincing histories costs more than the jobs pay, so attackers stop.
